text:
Ana: Quick follow-up from Quasar Labs onboarding — procurement won't sign renewal until they get an auditable CSV for chargebacks and a short enablement session.
Tom: What fields do they need?
Ana: They requested: account_id, route, date, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_usd, error_flag, user_id (hashed ok), and an errors timeline (timestamp + error_code). 90-day window. They want a presigned S3 link.
Leah: We can produce this from events_warehouse. Will redact raw transcripts and hash user_id with a salt. Need infra window to run the job so we don't impact peaks.
Ravi: Enablement can do a 15m call and a one-pager showing how to pivot the CSV for chargebacks. I'll record it for reuse.
Tom: Product note: recurring ask across mid-market. I'll add a backlog item "account-level per-route export + admin Console" with acceptance: schema doc, RBAC so only account admins can export, presigned link TTL, and audit logging.
Ana: Quasar Labs renewal sync is in 7 business days. They flagged this as blocking — high risk.
Leah: Short-term plan: I run a redacted export and upload to ops S3 with presigned link TTL=7d. Long-term: Console export.
Ana: Can you paste the export snippet you'll run?
Leah: ```bash
# redacted export (90d)
PS_SALT=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id export-hash-salt --query SecretString --output text)
psql events -c "COPY (SELECT account_id, route, recorded_at::date AS date, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, (prompt_tokens+completion_tokens)*rate AS cost_usd, COALESCE(error_code,'') AS error_flag, encode(digest(coalesce(user_email,'') || '$PS_SALT','sha256'),'hex') AS user_hash FROM events_raw WHERE recorded_at >= now() - interval '90 days') TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" > quasarlabs_export_90d.csv
aws s3 cp quasarlabs_export_90d.csv s3://redwood-exports/quasar/ && aws s3 presign s3://redwood-exports/quasar/quasarlabs_export_90d.csv --expires-in 604800
```
Tom: Action items: (1) Leah to deliver redacted CSV + presigned link by Wed EOD. (2) Ravi to prepare 15m enablement + one-pager. (3) Tom to file product ticket and tag security for RBAC/audit. Ana to confirm with customer.
Ops-Bot: Reminder — Quasar Labs renewal touchpoint scheduled in 7 business days (calendar invite sent).
Ana: I'll update Quasar Labs after the CSV is uploaded. Ravi: can you include a template email for finance?
Ravi: Yep, will attach the template and the recording.
Tom: I'll include the CSV schema and sample curl for presign generation in the product ticket.
Ana: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for owners and timeline.
